description: Published Cargo 0.19.0 confirmed to drain Fetch events at command boundaries; v0.22.0 not published. User explicitly approved switching Cargo build source to immutable upstream v0.22.0 commit ce1f1f5f8123b97f16aa08e9375659fcdf9c47ab with --locked. Files Dockerfile, priv/browser version+revision, docs/e2e-testing.md. Verify source command surface and local build if feasible; keep shared runtime and current timeouts. Test definition before changes: existing opt-in flow verifies exact CLI version and full form flow; negative allowlist scenario follows next. No new server, no allowlist weakening, no commit/push.
